company.name: Jordan Kuwait Bank
company.shortDescription: Jordan Kuwait Bank is a Jordanian public shareholding company, offers employees in public & private sector loans to cover personal needs.
company.description: Jordan Kuwait Bank operates as a commercial banking institution within the financial services sector. The organization provides personal, corporate, and private banking services to individual and commercial clients. It offers deposit accounts, including current accounts, savings plans, and fixed-term deposits. The business delivers personal financing, residential mortgage loans, auto loans, and commercial credit facilities. It issues credit cards, debit cards, and prepaid payment products under international payment networks.
